title: Austin's New City Leaders Declared
summary:
*   The special meeting was dedicated to the official certification of the city's General Election results from April 4, 1959.
*   After reviewing 10,738 votes, the winning candidates for the five City Representative positions were formally announced.
*   Hub Bechtol, Ben White, Tom Miller, Lester E. Palmer, and Edgar H. Perry III were declared the duly elected officials.
*   These new city representatives are set to begin their two-year terms on May 15, 1959.
